parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh and en. zh indicates Chinese, which is the default value. en indicates English.

parameters.name: EnableHttp2
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2 for negotiation between the server and client. This parameter applies to requests. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse enable-http2 --gateway-unique-id gw-0adf3ad751284cc69fcf9669fba00000 --enable-http2 true --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse EnableHttp2 --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-0adf3ad751284cc69fcf9669fba00000' --AcceptLanguage zh --EnableHttp2 true
